g.text: - 10µF capacitors outside of the RF section can be Class II MLCCs (X5R or X7R).

g.desc: - 10µF capacitors outside of the RF section can be Class II MLCCs (X5R or X7R).

g.text: - 10µF is the specified capacitance at 0V DC. It is fine for the capacitance with applied DC voltage to be under 10µF.

g.desc: - 10µF is the specified capacitance at 0V DC. It is fine for the capacitance with applied DC voltage to be under 10µF.

g.text: - Oscillator frequency should ideally be within the 472-479kHz band, centered on 475kHz.

g.desc: - Oscillator frequency should ideally be within the 472-479kHz band, centered on 475kHz.

g.text: Cut and solder to JP1 for external

g.desc: Cut and solder to JP1 for external

g.text: Note: External (not on board) barrel jack and switch are used.

g.desc: Note: External (not on board) barrel jack and switch are used.

g.text: D1 can be used for a diode for RPP, thermistor for inrush

g.desc: D1 can be used for a diode for RPP, thermistor for inrush

g.text: current limiting, for a fuse, or simply jumpered closed.

g.desc: current limiting, for a fuse, or simply jumpered closed.

g.text: but is outside of the 472-479kHz band.

g.desc: but is outside of the 472-479kHz band.

g.text: All capacitors in the RF section should be rated for at least 200V and be Class I (i.e. C0G/NP0).

g.desc: All capacitors in the RF section should be rated for at least 200V and be Class I (i.e. C0G/NP0).

g.text: Inductors L2-L5 should be wound on Kool Mu 0077932A7 cores using 22AWG or larger magnet wire.

g.desc: Inductors L2-L5 should be wound on Kool Mu 0077932A7 cores using 22AWG or larger magnet wire.

g.text: Approximate number of inductor turns: L2 = 14, L3 = 23, L4 = 23, L5 = 19

g.desc: Approximate number of inductor turns: L2 = 14, L3 = 23, L4 = 23, L5 = 19

g.text: Measure inductances at 475kHz on a VNA or at least 100kHz on a LCR. Try to be within ±0.2uH.

g.desc: Measure inductances at 475kHz on a VNA or at least 100kHz on a LCR. Try to be within ±0.2uH.

g.text: When tuning the inductors, make the coils closer together to increase inductance, or futher apart to decrease.

g.desc: When tuning the inductors, make the coils closer together to increase inductance, or futher apart to decrease.

g.text: L1 sees primarily DC current and is tolerant to variation in indcutance, hence it can be an SMD inductor.

g.desc: L1 sees primarily DC current and is tolerant to variation in indcutance, hence it can be an SMD inductor.
